title: Thomson Reuters (Professional) Australia Limited - completed acquisition of Allume Technology Partners Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the completed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: In 2008 Thomson Reuters acquired the Allume business, which was previously jointly owned by KPMG and Deloitte.  Allume was a tax technology company which specialised in providng technology solutions in tax compliance and management.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the completed acquisition in the context of national markets for the supply of income tax compliance software and fringe benefits tax (FBT) compliance software.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC's investigation indicated that post-acquisition, there remained two firms competing with the merged entity in each market.  In particular, the ACCC found that Ernst & Young's tax compliance software business continued to pose a signficant competitive constraint on the merged entity. Therefore, the ACCC concluded that the completed acquisition was unlikely to have resulted in a substantial lessening of competition in either of the relevant markets.
